text:
Liz M.: Heads-up — vendor lab flagged thermal/power constraints for a mixed rack with H100+Gaudi. Could affect our marketplace slotting windows.
Devon P.: Ugh. Which configs specifically?
Liz M.: Short summary from vendor: sustained power capping on racks with H100 + B200 accelerators when Gaudi present, spikes during long-context loads.
Amar K.: Can you paste the vendor note? We need exact numbers for the ops matrix.
Liz M.: Paste below from their email (redacted):

infra-bot: "ATTACHMENT: vendor-power-report-Q1.pdf"

Liz M.: Key bits: H100 sustained 350W, H200 420W, MI300 peaks 450W; Gaudi draws lower per-card but causes thermal headroom loss in shared PSUs.
Natalie R.: TL;DR: some rack combos reduce available GPU density — might force 2-phase onramp: small early waves then staggered fill.
Sam H. (hw-partner): Confirming — some of our SI customers saw PSUs throttle when mixing these SKUs; they recommended separate power zones or reserving fewer slots per rack.
Devon P.: Ok we need a concrete fallback for marketplace and SI onboarding. Proposed options:
- Option A: Dedicated racks per vendor SKU (safe, higher cost)
- Option B: Mixed racks but cap slot density and prioritize fast models (cheaper)
- Option C: Offer region-specific SKU gating (gradual rollouts)

Amar K.: Also need to update the compute compatibility matrix shown in the marketplace UI and add a note in the SI onboarding playbook.
Natalie R.: Can we show an automated banner that says "density-limited — expect reduced slot availability" on affected SKUs?
Devon P.: Yes. Small copy tweak. I'll own the UI banner if infra provides the flag.
Liz M.: Infra action: can we detect PSU headroom in the lab and expose a boolean flag in the compatibility API? @infra-bot?
infra-bot: Scheduled check: running power profile sweep this afternoon. Will publish /compatibility/power_flag.{json} if anomalies found.
Sam H. (hw-partner): From partner side, we can provide recommended rack layouts and a short table for customers. Attaching sample matrix below.
Liz M.: Nice — paste the matrix here so product can consume.
Sam H. (hw-partner): ```
recommended_slotting_v1:
H100: 350W sustained -> max 2 units per 48U rack zone
H200: 420W -> max 1 unit per 48U rack zone
MI300: 450W -> recommend isolated PSU, 1 per rack
Gaudi: 300W -> up to 3 units if PSU rated and thermal zoning applied
Mixed: H100+Gaudi -> reduce H100 density to 1 per zone
```
Amar K.: That helps. We should map these to marketplace SKU flags: "isolated_psu", "reduced_density", "embargo_window".
Natalie R.: Marketing/partners will need embargo windows for any joint announcement that references capacity. We should avoid public comms implying GA in zones that are density-limited.
Devon P.: Action items:
- @Sam H.: provide final rack diagrams + quick checklist by EOD Thurs (owner: Sam H.)
- @infra-bot: finish power sweep and post flag endpoint (owner: infra-bot)
- @Devon P.: add UI banner and SKU flag hooks (ETA Fri)
- @Liz M.: update SI playbook + add canary run plan (ETA next Tue)

Liz M.: Also proposing a short canary: enable Mixed SKU in one region with reduced density flag for 2 weeks, collect tail-latency + thermal metrics. If stable, expand.
Sam H. (hw-partner): Sounds reasonable. We'll provide an SI engineer for the canary day.
Amar K.: One more: we should add a short snippet in the console's rollout dialog explaining fallback behavior (auto-route to compatible variants if density hit).
Devon P.: I'll add that. Copy: "If capacity constrained, requests will automatically fall back to compatible variants — see docs."
Natalie R.: Great. Please cc partnerships when you have the embargo window dates so we can coordinate press + marketplace notes.
Liz M.: Thanks all. Looping @Sam H. for diagrams and @infra-bot for the power flag. Will post canary schedule once infra sweep returns. :thumbsup: 
Sam H. (hw-partner): :wave: got it, will send diagrams and checklist in the afternoon.
infra-bot: Power sweep completed. Flag endpoint published: https://internal-api.company/compatibility/power_flag.json
Liz M.: Received. Meeting to review the matrix tomorrow 9am PT. I'll send invite.
Natalie R.: Copy — will prepare embargo dates and draft partner comms after the canary results.
Amar K.: Thanks everyone. Closing the thread unless new blockers pop up.
